importantFindings: Sea Ray 340 Sundancer legacy 1984–2008 record was structurally invalid: three distinct generations are now separate canonical records (1984–89, 1999–2002, 2003–08).
Sea Ray 390 Motor Yacht and 40 Motor Yacht are one continuing 2003–07 model line with a 2006 marketing rename.
Endeavour 36 TrawlerCat is correctly full-displacement catamaran; Endeavour 44 remains a faster semi-displacement power-cat trawler.
Oceania 36 Sedan receives contemporary 1980 Canadian test specifications and is no longer conflated with a later Ocean Alexander record.
PDQ 34 PowerCat is canonicalized as a twin-diesel catamaran with separate shower and shallow 2 ft 4 in draft.
Saga 26 HT production range corrected to approximately 1990–2009; semi-planing/full-planing versions existed.
Holiday Mansion 38 Barracuda Coastal propulsion corrected from shaft to sterndrive/I-O; engine count remains configuration-specific.
Shannon 38 SRD hull behavior corrected from displacement to planing-capable reverse-deadrise; propulsion remains configuration-specific.
Universal 36 is strengthened as a full-displacement twin-diesel trawler from a documented 1977 hull; Universal 40 remains deliberately provisional where factory documentation is weak.
Sealord 34 remains a legitimate but low-confidence Chien Hwa/Taiwan trawler identity requiring HIN-level verification.
